about.registryInfo: Robbin Pagamentos LTDA (CNPJ 54.095.386/0001-91), São Paulo SP, Brazilian B2B-payments fintech founded 27/02/2024; co-branded credit cards for SMEs (Votorantim/Gerdau/Tigre via Juntos Somos Mais, CantuStore, CREDMOURA). Tokens issued via Liqi Securitizadora under CVM Resolution 88 (RCVM 88) as TIDC CR (Token de Investimento em Direitos Creditórios — Credit Rights Investment Token).
